name: APEBench
summary: 为一维至三维周期域偏微分方程生成时序数据的自回归模拟评测工具。
summaryEn: Generates temporal PDE data for autoregressive emulator evaluation on periodic 1D–3D domains.
scale: See publisher release and split documentation
scaleZh: 规模与分割以发布方文档为准
access: Official generation toolkit; run reference solvers to create data
accessZh: 官方生成工具；须自行运行参考求解器
license: Repository specifies MIT; dependencies have separate terms
licenseZh: 仓库标注 MIT；具体依赖另有条款
wmNote: 按方程与配置生成数据，不是单个固定数据包；误差和物理范围取决于数值求解配置。
wmNoteEn: Data are generated per equation/configuration rather than supplied as one fixed corpus; scope and numerical error depend on solver settings.

evidence.statement: The toolkit uses spectral reference simulators to generate PDE trajectories and evaluates autoregressive predictions over rollouts. Initial fields and subsequent numerical states form identifiable physical input/target pairs.
